data.name: BlendMode_ColorBurn_Description
data.value: Darkens the background by burning it with the foreground color.

data.name: BlendMode_ColorDodge_Description
data.value: Brightens the background by adding the foreground color.

data.name: BlendMode_Color_Description
data.value: Applies the foreground hue and saturation to the background's luminance.

data.name: BlendMode_Darken_Description
data.value: Keeps the darker color of the foreground or background.

data.name: BlendMode_DstATop_Description
data.value: Places the background on top and keeps the foreground outside.

data.name: BlendMode_DstIn_Description
data.value: Clips the background to the shape of the foreground.

data.name: BlendMode_DstOut_Description
data.value: Keeps the area outside the foreground for the background.

data.name: BlendMode_DstOver_Description
data.value: Places the background beneath the foreground.

data.name: BlendMode_HardLight_Description
data.value: Simulates a harsh spotlight effect to enhance contrast.

data.name: BlendMode_Hue_Description
data.value: Applies the foreground hue to the background's luminance and saturation.

data.name: BlendMode_Lighten_Description
data.value: Keeps the lighter color of the foreground or background.

data.name: BlendMode_Luminosity_Description
data.value: Applies the foreground luminance to the background's hue and saturation.

data.name: BlendMode_Modulate_Description
data.value: Combines the colors of the foreground and background based on their transparency (alpha values).

data.name: BlendMode_Multiply_Description
data.value: Multiplies the RGB color values of the foreground and background, creating a darker effect.

data.name: BlendMode_Overlay_Description
data.value: Combines the foreground and background to enhance contrast.

data.name: BlendMode_Plus_Description
data.value: Adds the colors of the foreground and background.

data.name: BlendMode_Saturation_Description
data.value: Applies the foreground saturation to the background's hue and luminance.

data.name: BlendMode_Screen_Description
data.value: Multiplies the inverted colors of the foreground and background, creating a lighter effect.

data.name: BlendMode_SoftLight_Description
data.value: Simulates a diffused spotlight for smoother lighting effects.

data.name: BlendMode_SrcATop_Description
data.value: Places the foreground on top and keeps the background outside.

data.name: BlendMode_SrcIn_Description
data.value: Clips the foreground to the shape of the background.

data.name: BlendMode_SrcOut_Description
data.value: Keeps the area outside the background for the foreground.

data.name: BlendMode_SrcOver_Description
data.value: Places the foreground over the background.

data.name: BlendMode_Xor_Description
data.value: Makes overlapping areas transparent, keeping non-overlapping areas.

data.name: Sharpen_Threshold_Description
data.value: Differences smaller than this are left alone, which keeps noise from standing out.

data.name: FilmGrain_Size_Description
data.value: The size of each grain cell in logical pixels.

data.name: FilmGrain_Softness_Description
data.value: Higher values smooth the transitions between grain cells.

data.name: FilmGrain_Color_Description
data.value: At 0%, all channels share the same grain. At 100%, each channel has its own grain.

data.name: FilmGrain_Animate_Description
data.value: Changes the grain pattern on each frame.

data.name: DiagonalClipping_Width_Description
data.value: 0 clips one side. Positive values clip outside the band; negative values clip inside it. The absolute value sets the band width.

data.name: LensChromaticAberration_Amount_Description
data.value: Scales the red channel by (1 + Amount/100) and the blue channel by (1 - Amount/100) around the center. The green channel stays in place. Negative values swap the fringe colors.

data.name: LensChromaticAberration_RepeatEdgePixels_Description
data.value: Where a channel reads past the picture's edge, it repeats the edge pixels, so the edges keep their colors and the result stays within the picture. When off, the fringes spread past the picture, which suits an object on a transparent background.

data.name: Vignette_Amount_Description
data.value: Positive values darken the edges. Negative values lighten the edges.

data.name: DelayAnimationEffect_Order_Description
data.value: Which part starts first. Position orders advance one typical part size per delay step. From center uses the distance to the center of the combined bounds. Parts at the same distance along the sweep start together.

data.name: DelayAnimationEffect_DelayMode_Description
data.value: Per step uses Delay for each step, in milliseconds. Total uses Delay for the time from the first part's start to the last part's start.

data.name: EdgeDetection_Threshold_Description
data.value: Changes smaller than this draw no line.

data.name: EdgeDetection_Strength_Description
data.value: How dark a change past the threshold draws its line. At 100% the line is solid from a change 10 points past the threshold, at 50% from 20 points past, and at 20% from 50 points past.

data.name: RepeatEffect_Spacing_Description
data.value: The gap between the copies. At 0 they touch.

data.name: RepeatEffect_Offset_Description
data.value: Moves the copies inside the grid. One that leaves at one end comes back at the other, so animating this scrolls without end.

data.name: Scene3D_AntiAliasing_Description
data.value: Smooths the edges of 3D objects. More samples look smoother but use more GPU memory and time.

data.name: RadialBlur_Amount_Description
data.value: Zoom expansion in percent, or the total spin angle in degrees.

data.name: Bokeh_Highlight_Description
data.value: Makes the bright parts brighter before they spread, so they stand out as shapes. 100% is twice as bright.

data.name: Bokeh_Quality_Description
data.value: More samples draw the shape more cleanly and take longer. High takes about three times as long as Low.

data.name: Bloom_SoftKnee_Description
data.value: Smooths the brightness threshold. 0% keeps a hard cutoff; 100% spreads the transition from zero to twice the threshold.

data.name: Bloom_Threshold_Description
data.value: Brightness used to select highlights in linear light. 1 is reference white.

data.name: Bloom_Intensity_Description
data.value: Glow strength multiplier. 0 disables the glow; 1 is normal strength.

data.name: LightRays_Center_Description
data.value: Relative to the complete input image. The center can also be placed outside the image.

data.name: LightRays_Length_Description
data.value: Outward extension relative to the distance from the center. 100% doubles that distance; 0 disables the rays.

data.name: LightRays_Decay_Description
data.value: Fades the light along each ray. 0% keeps an even strength; higher values fade more quickly.

data.name: MotionBlur_Description
data.value: Samples this drawable, its transforms, opacity and preceding effects at explicit times. Following effects apply once to the average in parent coordinates.

data.name: MotionBlur_ShutterAngle_Description
data.value: Exposure relative to one frame: 180° is half a frame, 360° is one, and 720° is two. Supports up to 3600° (10 frames). 0° disables temporal sampling.

data.name: MotionBlur_ShutterPosition_Description
data.value: Places the current frame at the start, center or end of the exposure interval.

data.name: MotionBlur_Samples_Description
data.value: 1–64 samples across the exposure. More samples reduce gaps but increase render time and memory use. 1 draws only the current time.

data.name: MotionBlur_SourceMix_Description
data.value: Mix in the current-time image: 0% is only motion blur, 100% is only the original. Static content keeps its opacity.

data.name: Echo_Description
data.value: Draws copies of the object at earlier or later times with decreasing opacity. Following effects apply once to the combined result.

data.name: Echo_Interval_Description
data.value: Time between copies in seconds. Negative values sample earlier times, positive values sample later times, and zero repeats the current time.

data.name: Echo_Count_Description
data.value: Total number of copies, including the current time (1–64). More copies use more rendering time and memory.

data.name: Echo_StartingIntensity_Description
data.value: Opacity of the current-time copy. At 0%, all copies are transparent.

data.name: Echo_Decay_Description
data.value: Percentage of opacity retained by each successive copy. At 0%, only the current-time copy is drawn. At 100%, all copies use the same opacity.

data.name: Echo_BlendMode_Description
data.value: Draw the chronologically newest copy on top or add the colors where copies overlap.

data.name: SteppedMotion_Description
data.value: Holds each sampled frame until the next, with timing measured from the start of the element.

data.name: SteppedMotion_FrameRate_Description
data.value: The number of samples per second. Lower values hold each frame for longer. To change the rate over time, use keyframes: a rate from an expression applies to the whole time since the start.

data.name: MeshWarp_Mesh_Description
data.value: Drag the control points in the preview. The handles show the full mesh at every strength.

data.name: MeshWarp_EditingPreviewHint
data.value: Editing mesh points. Later effects are hidden in the preview.

data.name: CornerPin_EditingPreviewHint
data.value: Drag the corners to adjust perspective. Later effects are hidden in the preview.

data.name: Puppet_PlacementHint
data.value: Click the image to place pins. Esc to finish.

data.name: Puppet_EditingPreviewHint
data.value: Editing Puppet pins. Later effects are hidden in the preview.

data.name: Puppet_PlacementUnavailable
data.value: There is no visible image to place pins on in this frame.

data.name: Puppet_PositionDescription
data.value: Image-relative coordinates. The upper-left corner is (0, 0) and the lower-right corner is (1, 1).

data.name: Puppet_LibraryDescription
data.value: Bends an image by placing and moving pins (puppet pin, puppet tool, deform).

data.name: EllipseShape_LibraryDescription
data.value: Draws a circle or ellipse that can also serve as a matte (ellipse, shape, solid, mask, track matte).

data.name: RectShape_LibraryDescription
data.value: Draws a rectangle that can also serve as a matte (rectangle, shape, solid, mask, track matte).

data.name: RoundedRectShape_LibraryDescription
data.value: Draws a rounded rectangle that can also serve as a matte (rounded rectangle, shape, solid, mask, track matte).

data.name: GeometryShape_LibraryDescription
data.value: Draws a custom shape from a vector path for artwork or masking (vector path, custom shape, layer mask, track matte).

data.name: TextBlock_LibraryDescription
data.value: Adds styled text to the scene (title, caption, subtitle).

data.name: SourceVideo_LibraryDescription
data.value: Plays a video file in the scene (video clip, footage).

data.name: SourceImage_LibraryDescription
data.value: Displays a still image from a file (still image, image layer).

data.name: SourceBackdrop_LibraryDescription
data.value: Applies effects to everything below it (adjustment layer).

data.name: Scene3D_LibraryDescription
data.value: Renders 3D objects and lights through a camera (3D composition, 3D scene).

data.name: Cube3D_LibraryDescription
data.value: Adds a box with adjustable width, height and depth (3D box, cube primitive).

data.name: Sphere3D_LibraryDescription
data.value: Adds a sphere with adjustable radius and detail (3D sphere, sphere primitive).

data.name: Plane3D_LibraryDescription
data.value: Adds a flat rectangular surface in 3D space (3D plane, surface primitive).

data.name: Model3D_LibraryDescription
data.value: Loads a 3D model from a file into the scene (3D model import, mesh import).

data.name: DrawableObject3D_LibraryDescription
data.value: Places 2D content on a flat card in a 3D scene (3D layer, image plane, 2.5D).

data.name: DirectionalLight3D_LibraryDescription
data.value: Illuminates a 3D scene with parallel rays like sunlight (sun light, parallel light).

data.name: PointLight3D_LibraryDescription
data.value: Emits light in all directions from one point in a 3D scene (point light, omni light).

data.name: SpotLight3D_LibraryDescription
data.value: Casts a cone of light in a 3D scene (spotlight, cone light).

data.name: ParticleEmitter_LibraryDescription
data.value: Emits and animates many small objects such as sparks or snow (particle system, particle generator).

data.name: NodeGraphDrawable_LibraryDescription
data.value: Generates visuals from a graph of connected nodes (node-based graphics, procedural graphics).

data.name: SceneDrawable_LibraryDescription
data.value: Displays another scene as a single visual layer (precomp, pre-compose, nested sequence, compound clip).

data.name: DrawableDecorator_LibraryDescription
data.value: Applies transforms, opacity, blending and effects separately to each child, using its own bounds and transform origin (effect group).

data.name: DrawableGroup_LibraryDescription
data.value: Transforms children around a shared origin. Opacity and blending apply to the whole group, and effects can use its bounds (parent, null object).

data.name: DrawableTimeController_LibraryDescription
data.value: Changes playback position and speed. Frame rate sets the time steps for evaluating the object (time remap, speed ramp, freeze frame).

data.name: AudioWaveformDrawable_LibraryDescription
data.value: Draws the amplitude of audio over time (audio waveform, waveform visualizer).

data.name: AudioSpectrumDrawable_LibraryDescription
data.value: Shows the level of different frequencies in audio (audio spectrum, spectrum analyzer).

data.name: AudioSpectrogramDrawable_LibraryDescription
data.value: Shows how audio frequencies change over time using color (spectrogram, frequency heatmap).

data.name: TranslateTransform_LibraryDescription
data.value: Moves an object horizontally and vertically (position, translation).

data.name: SkewTransform_LibraryDescription
data.value: Tilts an object by slanting its sides (skew, shear).

data.name: ScaleTransform_LibraryDescription
data.value: Resizes an object horizontally and vertically (scale, resize).

data.name: RotationTransform_LibraryDescription
data.value: Turns an object around its pivot in the image plane (rotation, 2D rotate).

data.name: Rotation3DTransform_LibraryDescription
data.value: Tilts and rotates a flat object in perspective (3D rotation, perspective transform).

data.name: Blur_LibraryDescription
data.value: Softens the image with a Gaussian blur (Gaussian blur, soft focus).

data.name: Sharpen_LibraryDescription
data.value: Makes details stand out by increasing contrast around edges (unsharp mask, sharpen details).

data.name: RadialBlur_LibraryDescription
data.value: Blurs the image as if it zoomed or spun around a point (zoom blur, spin blur).

data.name: MotionBlur_LibraryDescription
data.value: Averages the object's appearance over a shutter interval, blurring movement (shutter blur).

data.name: Echo_LibraryDescription
data.value: Layers copies from earlier or later times at set intervals, with adjustable fading (afterimage, ghost trail, motion trails).

data.name: SteppedMotion_LibraryDescription
data.value: Holds each sampled frame until the next sample. Later effects can keep animating (frame hold, stop motion, low frame rate, posterize time).

data.name: Bokeh_LibraryDescription
data.value: Softens the image using the shape of a lens aperture (lens blur, defocus).

data.name: Bloom_LibraryDescription
data.value: Makes bright areas glow into their surroundings (glow, bloom).

data.name: LightRays_LibraryDescription
data.value: Stretches highlights into rays radiating from a point (god rays, volumetric light).

data.name: WaveRefraction_LibraryDescription
data.value: Distorts the image like light refracting through rippling water (ripple, wave distortion).

data.name: PolarCoordinates_LibraryDescription
data.value: Wraps a flat image around a center or unwraps it back into a strip (rectangular to polar, polar to rectangular).

data.name: DropShadow_LibraryDescription
data.value: Casts an offset shadow behind the object (drop shadow, cast shadow).

data.name: InnerShadow_LibraryDescription
data.value: Darkens the inside edges to give the object depth (inner shadow, inset shadow).

data.name: FlatShadow_LibraryDescription
data.value: Extends a solid shadow from the object in one direction (long shadow, flat shadow).

data.name: StrokeEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Draws a line along the object's silhouette (outline, border, stroke).

data.name: Clipping_LibraryDescription
data.value: Crops the image inward from its four sides (crop, trim, mask).

data.name: DiagonalClipping_LibraryDescription
data.value: Crops the image along an angled edge or strip (crop, trim, mask, diagonal wipe).

data.name: Dilate_LibraryDescription
data.value: Expands the bright or opaque parts of the image (expand, grow matte, matte choker).

data.name: Erode_LibraryDescription
data.value: Shrinks the bright or opaque parts of the image (shrink, choke, matte choker).

data.name: HighContrast_LibraryDescription
data.value: Adjusts image contrast with optional grayscale and inversion (contrast boost, black and white).

data.name: HueRotate_LibraryDescription
data.value: Shifts colors around the color wheel (hue shift, hue offset).

data.name: Lighting_LibraryDescription
data.value: Applies a color multiplier and offset to the image (color multiply, color add).

data.name: LumaColor_LibraryDescription
data.value: Converts image luminance into transparency (luma to alpha, luminance matte).

data.name: Saturate_LibraryDescription
data.value: Makes colors more vivid or less intense (saturation, desaturate).

data.name: Threshold_LibraryDescription
data.value: Divides the image into light and dark regions at a brightness cutoff (binarize, black and white threshold).

data.name: EdgeDetection_LibraryDescription
data.value: Draws lines where brightness, color or transparency changes (find edges, contour).

data.name: Brightness_LibraryDescription
data.value: Lightens or darkens the whole image (brighten, darken).

data.name: OpacityEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Changes transparency at this point in the effect stack. Use the object's Opacity for an overall fade (alpha, transparency).

data.name: Gamma_LibraryDescription
data.value: Lightens or darkens midtones to adjust tonal balance (gamma correction, midtones).

data.name: ColorGrading_LibraryDescription
data.value: Adjusts the overall colors and tones of the image (color correction, white balance, grading).

data.name: Curves_LibraryDescription
data.value: Remaps brightness and individual color channels with curves (tone curve, RGB curves).

data.name: FilmGrain_LibraryDescription
data.value: Adds a fine noise pattern that looks like film grain (noise, grain).

data.name: Vignette_LibraryDescription
data.value: Darkens the edges of the image around a chosen center, or lightens them with a negative amount (lens vignette, edge darkening).

data.name: Invert_LibraryDescription
data.value: Inverts image colors and can also invert the alpha channel (invert colors).

data.name: LutEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Remaps colors using a lookup table (color lookup, LUT, color grading).

data.name: BlendEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Blends a brush with the image. Use the object's Blend Mode to blend with layers below (color overlay, tint).

data.name: Negaposi_LibraryDescription
data.value: Subtracts image colors from a reference RGB color. With the default settings, the image appears black (color negative).

data.name: ChromaKey_LibraryDescription
data.value: Removes a background by its hue and saturation and suppresses the key color spilling onto the subject (green screen, blue screen, keylight, despill, spill suppressor).

data.name: ColorKey_LibraryDescription
data.value: Makes pixels close to a chosen color transparent (keying, color key, color matte).

data.name: LumaKey_LibraryDescription
data.value: Makes parts of the image transparent according to their brightness (keying, luminance key, luma matte).

data.name: SplitEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Divides the image into a grid of pieces that can be spaced apart (grid split, slice).

data.name: PartsSplitEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Separates disconnected visible parts of the image into pieces (split by alpha, separate islands).

data.name: RepeatEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Makes copies of the image in rows and columns (tile, motion tile, repeater).

data.name: TransformEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Moves, scales or rotates the image within the effect stack (position, scale, rotation).

data.name: MosaicEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Replaces image detail with blocks of color (pixelate, censor).

data.name: ColorShift_LibraryDescription
data.value: Moves red, green, blue and alpha by separate horizontal and vertical offsets (RGB split, channel shift).

data.name: LensChromaticAberration_LibraryDescription
data.value: Scales red and blue around a center, enlarging one and shrinking the other to mimic lens fringing (chromatic aberration).

data.name: ShakeEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Shakes the image at an adjustable speed and strength (wiggle, camera shake).

data.name: DisplacementMapEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Distorts the image by moving pixels according to a displacement map (distort, warp, displacement map).

data.name: MeshWarp_LibraryDescription
data.value: Deforms the image by moving control points on a grid (mesh distortion, grid warp).

data.name: CornerPin_LibraryDescription
data.value: Maps the image to four movable corners (perspective warp, four-point transform, CC Power Pin).

data.name: PathFollowEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Moves an object along a path and can turn it to follow the path (motion path, path animation).

data.name: LayerEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Combines separate effect outputs into a single image (flatten, merge layers).

data.name: DelayAnimationEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Staggers an animated effect across copies, pieces or text characters so they animate one after another (stagger, time offset, text animator).

data.name: PixelSortEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Sorts runs of pixels by brightness or color to create streaks (pixel sorting, streak glitch).

data.name: NodeGraphFilterEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Processes the image through a graph of connected effect nodes (node-based compositing, node effect).

data.name: CSharpScriptEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Runs a C# script to apply a custom effect (C# scripting, scripted effect).

data.name: SKSLScriptEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Processes the image with a custom Skia shader written in SkSL (Skia shader, custom shader).

data.name: GLSLScriptEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Processes the image with a GLSL fragment shader (fragment shader, custom shader).

data.name: CrossDissolveTransition_LibraryDescription
data.value: Blends the outgoing clip into the incoming clip as their opacities change together (crossfade, dissolve).

data.name: FadeTransition_LibraryDescription
data.value: Fades out the outgoing clip to transparency before fading in the incoming clip (fade in, fade out).

data.name: WipeTransition_LibraryDescription
data.value: Reveals the incoming clip behind a moving edge or an expanding shape (linear wipe, clock wipe).

data.name: DipToColorTransition_LibraryDescription
data.value: Fades the outgoing clip to a solid color before revealing the incoming clip (fade through color, dip to black).

data.name: PushTransition_LibraryDescription
data.value: Moves the incoming clip into the frame as it pushes the outgoing clip out (push wipe, slide push).

data.name: SlideTransition_LibraryDescription
data.value: Slides the incoming clip over the outgoing clip (slide in, slide wipe).

data.name: ZoomTransition_LibraryDescription
data.value: Zooms the clips around the center of the frame as they dissolve (zoom in, zoom out, zoom dissolve).

data.name: IrisTransition_LibraryDescription
data.value: Reveals or hides a clip through an opening that expands or contracts from the center (iris wipe, circle reveal).

data.name: SplitTransition_LibraryDescription
data.value: Parts the outgoing clip from the center to reveal the incoming clip (split wipe, barn doors).

data.name: BlindsTransition_LibraryDescription
data.value: Reveals the incoming clip in parallel strips that open like blinds (venetian blinds, strip wipe).

data.name: CheckerboardTransition_LibraryDescription
data.value: Reveals the incoming clip by expanding alternating checkerboard tiles first (checker wipe, tile reveal).

data.name: ZoomBlurTransition_LibraryDescription
data.value: Zooms the image and peaks the radial blur at the cut (zoom blur, radial blur transition).

data.name: WhipPanTransition_LibraryDescription
data.value: Sweeps across the cut with directional blur like a fast camera pan (swish pan, pan blur).

data.name: GlitchTransition_LibraryDescription
data.value: Breaks up the cut with shifting horizontal bands and separated colors (digital glitch, RGB split).

data.name: LightLeakTransition_LibraryDescription
data.value: Sweeps a warm light leak and a flare across the cut (film burn, light flash).

data.name: RangeAnimatorEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Animates a selected range of split text characters or parts produced by Split by parts.

data.name: RangeAnimatorEffect_Smoothness_Description
data.value: Softens the edges of the Square shape. At 100%, each part gets the fraction of its slot covered by the range. At 0%, its center decides whether it is selected.

data.name: TextOnPathEffect_LibraryDescription
data.value: Lay out text along a path. Enable Split by characters on the text.
